summary: Trivial setter: reads the object pointer stored at *this, writes the incoming byte argument a2 into that object at byte offset 93 (0x5D), and returns the object pointer. Called by SynchronizeWithServer.

local_names.this: pointer-to-pointer; dereferenced to obtain the target object
local_names.a2: byte value written to the target field
local_names.result: the target object pointer, returned unchanged

operations.description: Load the target object pointer from the dword at *this into result.
Write the byte argument a2 to the target object at offset 93 (0x5D), unconditionally overwriting the flag/state byte.
Return the object pointer (the value loaded from *this before the write).
Invoked by SynchronizeWithServer during server state synchronization; the semantic role of the 0x5D byte is caller-supplied and not evident here.

unresolved: The meaning of the byte at offset 93 (0x5D) and the object type behind *this are not established by this packet.
